문장.x: Try making a sentence with this word.

그냥.forms: 그냥 + verb: 그냥 가요 · as an answer: 그냥요 (just because)
그냥.m: just, simply; as it is, without any reason
그냥.x: Today I just want to rest at home.
그냥.t: 왜요? — 그냥요. ('Why?' — 'Just because.') Very common in speech.

은-는.forms: 은 after a consonant (책은) · 는 after a vowel (저는)
은-는.e: 은 after a consonant (책은), 는 after a vowel (저는 = as for me).
은-는.t: 은/는 marks what you're talking about; 이/가 marks new information. 'Who came?' → 누가 왔어요?

듣기.m: listening (as a skill or test section)
듣기.ex: 듣기 실력을 높이려고 한국 드라마를 봐요.
듣기.x: I watch Korean dramas to improve my listening skills.
듣기.e: Verb 듣다 'to listen' plus noun-making -기; ㄷ stays ㄷ before -기.

댓글.ex: 제 글에 댓글이 백 개나 달렸어요.
댓글.x: My post got as many as a hundred comments.
댓글.e: From 대 'in response to' + 글 'writing'; the ㅅ joins the two parts.
댓글.t: Write a comment is 댓글을 달다/쓰다; comments appear is 댓글이 달리다.

부탁하다.x: I asked my younger sibling to pick up some milk.
부탁하다.t: Pronounced [부타카다] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

혈압.ex: 할아버지는 혈압이 높아서 매일 약을 드세요.
혈압.x: My grandfather has high blood pressure, so he takes medicine every day.
혈압.t: Pronounced [혀랍] — the ㄹ carries over to the next syllable.

대학원.ex: 졸업 후에 대학원에 가서 공부를 더 하고 싶어요.
대학원.x: After graduating, I want to go to grad school and study more.
대학원.e: Literally 'university institute' — the institute above 대학 (college).

자랑하다.m: to boast, to show off, to brag about
자랑하다.ex: 친구가 저에게 새로 산 휴대폰을 자랑했어요.
자랑하다.x: My friend showed off his new phone to me.
자랑하다.e: 자랑 'something to be proud of' + 하다; also gives 자랑스럽다 'proud'.

고생.x: I went through a lot of trouble moving.
고생.t: 고생 많으셨어요 thanks someone for their hard work; 고생하다 is the verb.

사용.x: Please refrain from using your phone in the library.
사용.t: 사용 is for tools and things; 이용 is for services and facilities like the subway.

안정.m: stability, security (of a job, prices, etc.)
안정.ex: 요즘은 직업의 안정을 가장 중요하게 생각하는 사람이 많아요.
안정.x: These days many people consider job stability the most important thing.
안정.t: A homonym 안정 (different hanja) means 'rest, calm', as in 절대 안정 'complete bed rest'.

운영.m: operation, management, running (of a business or facility)
운영.x: The library's operating hours are until 6 p.m.
운영.e: Literally 'move and manage' — keep something running.

대중문화.ex: 한국 대중문화는 전 세계에서 인기가 많아요.
대중문화.x: Korean pop culture is very popular around the world.

퇴직.x: My father is going to retire next year.

잔액.x: My transit card balance was low, so I topped it up at the subway station.
잔액.t: You'll hear 잔액이 부족합니다 on Korean buses when your card runs low.

장례식장.x: My grandmother passed away, so I went to the funeral hall today.
장례식장.t: Pronounced [장녜식짱]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ, and ㅈ turns tense after ㄱ. Most Korean funerals are held in funeral halls attached to hospitals, usually over three days.

뾰족하다.x: I sharpened the pencil to a fine point.
뾰족하다.t: Pronounced [뾰조카다]: ㄱ + ㅎ becomes ㅋ. 뾰족한 수가 없다 = 'there's no good way out'.

태블릿.x: I watch movies or draw pictures on my tablet.
태블릿.e: From English 'tablet'; also called 태블릿 PC.

위성.x: The moon is the only satellite Earth has.
위성.e: Literally 'guarding star': a body that circles a planet.
위성.t: 위성 also shortens 인공위성 in compounds: 위성 사진, 위성 방송.

위약금.m: penalty for breaking a contract, cancellation fee
위약금.x: I canceled my phone contract early, so I had to pay a penalty.
위약금.t: Collocation: 위약금을 물다 or 위약금을 내다 = to pay a penalty.

보상.ex: 열심히 노력한 만큼 좋은 보상을 받았어요.
보상.x: I got a good reward for all the effort I put in.

모색하다.m: to seek, to look for, to explore (ways or solutions)
모색하다.ex: 정부는 실업 문제의 해결 방안을 모색하고 있습니다.
모색하다.x: The government is seeking solutions to the unemployment problem.
모색하다.e: Literally 'grope and search', like feeling your way in the dark.
모색하다.t: Pronounced [모새카다]; usually with 방법, 방안 or 대책 as the object.

애를 먹다.forms: 애를 먹어요 · 애를 먹었어요 · V-느라 애를 먹다
애를 먹다.m: to have a hard time, to struggle with
애를 먹다.ex: 길을 몰라서 호텔을 찾느라 애를 먹었어요.
애를 먹다.x: I didn't know the way, so I had a hard time finding the hotel.
애를 먹다.e: 애 = anxious trouble; literally 'to swallow trouble.'
애를 먹다.t: Don't confuse it with 애를 쓰다: 쓰다 is trying hard, 먹다 is going through trouble.

연속.x: That athlete won the championship three years in a row.
연속.t: Number + 연속 means 'in a row': 3일 연속, 5경기 연속.

눈을 붙이다.forms: 눈 좀 붙여요 · 잠깐 눈을 붙였어요 · 눈을 붙이세요
눈을 붙이다.m: to get some sleep, to grab a nap (lit. to stick the eyes together)
눈을 붙이다.ex: 피곤하면 이동하는 동안 잠깐 눈을 붙이세요.
눈을 붙이다.x: If you're tired, get some sleep for a bit on the way.
눈을 붙이다.e: The eyelids are 'stuck together' (붙이다 'to attach') — closing your eyes for a short sleep.
눈을 붙이다.t: Usually a short sleep: 잠깐, 좀 or 한숨 눈을 붙이다. 붙이다 is pronounced [부치다].

제곱미터.x: This apartment is 84 square meters, so it's good for a family.
제곱미터.t: Home sizes are officially given in 제곱미터, but many people still talk in 평 (1평 ≈ 3.3 m²).

내각.ex: 새 총리는 다음 주에 내각을 구성할 예정입니다.
내각.x: The new prime minister plans to form a cabinet next week.
내각.e: Literally 'inner pavilion', the ruler's inner council.

흥망성쇠.m: rise and fall, ups and downs
흥망성쇠.ex: 이 책은 로마 제국의 흥망성쇠를 다루고 있어요.
흥망성쇠.x: This book covers the rise and fall of the Roman Empire.

침략.ex: 그 나라는 여러 번 이웃 나라의 침략을 받았어요.
침략.x: That country was invaded by its neighbors several times.
침략.t: Pronounced [침냑] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅁ.

협상력.ex: 이번 회담에서 우리 정부의 협상력이 시험대에 올랐습니다.
협상력.x: Our government's negotiating power was put to the test at these talks.
협상력.e: Literally 'negotiation power'. -력 = power or ability: 경쟁력, 군사력, 억지력.
협상력.t: Pronounced [협쌍녁]: ㅇ + ㄹ turns ㄹ into ㄴ.

부상하다.m: to emerge, to rise (to prominence); to surface
부상하다.ex: 인공지능이 새로운 성장 산업으로 부상하고 있습니다.
부상하다.x: Artificial intelligence is emerging as a new growth industry.
부상하다.e: Literally 'float up' — rising to the surface and getting noticed.
부상하다.t: Homonym 부상 (負傷) means injury: 부상을 입다. Pattern for this sense: N(으)로 부상하다.

신중히.x: Investment decisions should be made carefully.

일취월장.m: rapid progress, improving day by day
일취월장.ex: 그 선수의 실력이 요즘 일취월장하고 있어요.
일취월장.x: That athlete's skills are improving by leaps and bounds these days.
일취월장.t: Here 일 means 'day', not 'one' — don't confuse it with the other 일- idioms.

눈시울을 붉히다.forms: 눈시울을 붉혀요 · 눈시울을 붉혔어요 · 눈시울을 붉히며
눈시울을 붉히다.m: to be moved to tears; to have one's eyes well up
눈시울을 붉히다.x: At her daughter's graduation, the mother's eyes welled up with tears.
눈시울을 붉히다.e: 눈시울 = the rims of the eyes; literally 'to redden the eye rims.'
눈시울을 붉히다.t: Pronounced [불키다]; a softer, more literary way to say someone almost cried.

플렉스.ex: 첫 월급 받고 부모님 선물로 플렉스했어요.
플렉스.x: I got my first paycheck and splurged on gifts for my parents.
플렉스.e: From English 'flex' (to show off), spread through hip-hop culture.
플렉스.t: Casual, often half-joking about treating yourself or others: 오늘은 내가 플렉스! 'Today it's on me!'

소급.ex: 새 법은 과거의 사건에 소급하여 적용되지 않습니다.
소급.x: The new law does not apply retroactively to past cases.
소급.e: Literally 'go upstream and reach' — reaching back into the past.

탈법.m: evasion of the law, circumventing the law
탈법.ex: 탈법은 불법은 아니지만 법의 취지를 무시하는 행위입니다.
탈법.x: Evading the law isn't technically illegal, but it ignores the purpose of the law.
탈법.e: Literally 'slipping out of the law': dodging it through loopholes.

모욕죄.m: criminal insult (public insult as an offense)
모욕죄.ex: 온라인에서 욕설을 한 사람이 모욕죄로 고소당했어요.
모욕죄.x: A person who posted insults online had a criminal complaint filed against them for insult.
모욕죄.t: 모욕죄 covers insults without facts; stating damaging facts or lies is 명예훼손 (defamation).

정전협정.x: The fighting in the Korean War stopped with the 1953 armistice agreement.
정전협정.e: Literally 'agreement to stop the war' — fighting halts but no peace treaty.
정전협정.t: Also called 휴전협정; it halted fighting but didn't formally end the Korean War.

단행하다.m: to carry out (decisively), to push ahead with
단행하다.x: The government pushed ahead with large-scale restructuring.
단행하다.t: Used for bold moves: 개혁, 인사, 구조 조정을 단행하다.

부각되다.m: to be highlighted, to come to the fore, to stand out
부각되다.ex: 최근 환경 문제가 크게 부각되고 있습니다.
부각되다.x: Environmental issues have recently come to the fore.
부각되다.e: Literally 'carved in relief' — something raised so it stands out.

표명하다.ex: 정부는 그 사건에 대해 유감을 표명했습니다.
표명하다.x: The government expressed regret over the incident.
표명하다.t: Formulaic phrases: 유감을 표명하다, 입장을 표명하다, 사의를 표명하다 'to offer to resign'.

퇴락하다.m: to fall into decay, to decline, to become dilapidated
퇴락하다.ex: 한때 번성했던 그 마을은 이제 퇴락했습니다.
퇴락하다.x: That once-thriving village has now fallen into decay.
퇴락하다.e: Literally 'crumble and fall' — buildings or families losing former glory.

대척점.ex: 두 사람의 생각은 완전히 대척점에 서 있어요.
대척점.x: The two people's views stand at completely opposite poles.
대척점.e: Literally 'soles-facing point' — the spot on the other side of the Earth.
대척점.t: Pronounced [대척쩜]; common pattern: ~의 대척점에 서다 'to be the opposite of ~'.

동가홍상.m: if the price is the same, pick the nicer one
동가홍상.ex: 동가홍상이라고, 가격이 같으면 디자인이 예쁜 걸 사세요.
동가홍상.x: If the price is the same, buy the one with the nicer design.
동가홍상.e: Literally 'same price, red skirt': at equal cost, choose the prettier.
